datasets.name: c9d0bcea
queryLines:
SELECT 
  `country`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `customer_id`) AS customer_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT `customer_id`) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `customer_id`) FROM `ecommerce`.`gold`.`gld_dim_customers`), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM `ecommerce`.`gold`.`gld_dim_customers`
GROUP BY `country`
ORDER BY customer_count DESC

datasets.name: top_brands_revenue
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.brand_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM
  ecommerce.gold.gld_fact_order_items f
    JOIN ecommerce.gold.gld_dim_products p
      ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.brand_name
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
